title: Introducing OpenDesign Motion
body:
An open-source alternative to Claude Motion. Turn ideas into videos with code.
Better editing and previews: Refine your work more smoothly. New files appear promptly after generation.
Continue on another device: Receive shared project updates on the same account. Confirm before replacing local files.

zh-CN.title: OpenDesign Motion 正式登场
zh-CN.body:
Claude Motion 的开源替代方案，用代码让创意变成视频。
编辑与预览优化：作品修改更顺畅，新文件生成后及时显示。
跨设备接续：同账号接收共享项目更新，确认后替换本地内容。
